notes.title: Ships At Sea
notes.content:
Ahoy, Navigators!

We're excited to announce that the Early Access version of our highly anticipated game, [b]Ships At Sea[/b], is now available! After months of hard work, dedication, and invaluable feedback from our community, we're ready to set sail with you on this incredible new simulation adventure.

[previewyoutube=Wp8lT01p9CM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What is Ships At Sea?[/h3]

Ships at Sea is a captivating ship simulator that allows you to take command of various vessels such as cargo, service, and fishing boats. You can navigate treacherous waters and experience the life of a mariner. With stunning graphics, licensed boats and equipment, and a richly detailed world, the game promises to immerse you in the maritime world like never before. Additionally, Ships at Sea includes a multiplayer mode for up to 4 players, where each player has their own boat to complete tasks, and one player hosts the game. This setup allows you to explore and navigate the open seas with friends, enhancing the simulation experience. Co-op functionality is currently in development and will be featured after the Early Access release.

[h3]Why Early Access?[/h3]

Early Access allows us to open our docks to you, our dedicated players, to help shape the final stages of development. Your feedback is crucial in ensuring that Ships At Sea becomes the ultimate ship simulation experience. Don't worry if you start on a small boat, just like in real life, everyone begins their journey with a modest vessel. During our Early Access period until the final version, you will progress and unlock the next level of your boat class certification, you'll gain access to larger and more powerful ships. Each new boat class offers tailored gameplay features. Your ultimate goal is to command these impressive vessels:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/ca974ca76ffd8133bafafb20ed7ff1086011ca2b.png[/img]

[h3]What's Included in Early Access?[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Realistic Ship Handling:[/b] Experience the thrill of piloting 7 different boats, with more to come during the EA period.
[*][b]Detailed Environments[/b]: Navigate through different weather conditions, day-night cycles, and dynamic water and buoyancy physics. 
[*][b]Career Mode:[/b] Start as an amateur sailor and progress to become a captain navigator, undertaking various missions and challenges.
[*][b]Exploration:[/b] Discover ports and enter the shipyard.
[*][b]Multiplayer Mode:[/b] Team up with up to 3 friends in a multiplayer experience where one player hosts the game. 
[/list]

[h3]Your Feedback Matters[/h3]

We are committed to making Ships At Sea the best it can be, and we can't do it without you. Join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/K53yAnZJtH]Discord[/url]. Thank you for your continued support. Together, we'll navigate the uncharted waters and create something truly special.

Fair winds and following seas, 

- Team Misc Games

notes.title: Update 1.7.901.10367
notes.content:
Ahoy all fishermen,

A new major update version: 1.7.901.10367 is now ready for download. We have been working really hard the past months with this major update that comes with several new features, two new boats, several improvements and fixes.

[h3]RTX Support[/h3]

Fishing: North Atlantic now supports ray tracing. To enable this graphical feature you need to enable DirectX 12. This is done via [b]Options -> Video[/b]. Select DirectX 12, then restart the game. You will now be able to adjust the Ray Tracing to your likings.

[i][b]Note:[/b][/i] Be aware that this feature is very demanding on performance!

[h3]Two New Boats[/h3]

We added two new free boats, one is the legendary Andrea Gail that sank north-east of Sable Island on October 28, 1991. Our second boat is Mostein, from our new licensepartner [url=https://www.breeze.no/]Breeze[/url].

Andrea Gail is a deepline boat and can be found at the docks in Lunenburg.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38125914/02569badd8c3750421978831e664d5fb3b91e401.png[/img]

Mostein is a small pelagic trawler and is found at the docks in Lockeport.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38125914/2b277085d6c3fec2d7091955ad918a333215b9a0.png[/img]

[h3]Game Options[/h3]

We adjusted the game options to be connected to each savegame instead of global. If you see that your fast travel is not working, please check [b]Options->Game[/b] from Main Menu and confirm that these options are enabled.

[i][b]Note:[/b][/i] Be aware that you might need to enable certain game options again on older savegames!

[h3]New Weather System[/h3]

There is a new weather system in place, with volumetric clouds, lightning, new rain and snow particles. We also improved the waves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38125914/cf97dd40bfa1e13f118f9e4efe4fe7bfe922bb73.png[/img]

[h3]New Custom Start Option[/h3]

We added a new custom start option, which has been highly requested by many players. You are now able to choose starter boats, date, adjust habitat size and fish prices.

[i][b]Note:[/b][/i] 100 is default for both selections. You can have the habitat size and fish prices 50% less or higher. This feature only works when you create a new game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38125914/06a4a49f422598c91cf72da68f16e6c849629759.png[/img]

[h3]Two New Licenspartners[/h3]

We are proud to announce that we now have two new licensepartners onboard. First is [url=https://www.breeze.no/]Breeze Ship Design[/url], which are specialists in naval architecture and has a reference to over 4000 built vessels worldwide.

Second is [url=https://norsap.no/]NorSap[/url], which are the leading manufacturer of high-quality chairs to the maritime and offshore industry.

Mostein is a boat designed by Breeze and you find NorSap's 1600 chair in Mostein as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38125914/e103e4f4b5d699a9d3cbc9e80fefa010ba10bb34.png[/img]

[h3]Trawldoor controls[/h3]

Another feature that has been highly requested is the possibilty to control the trawldoors when you have your Scanmar system in fullscreen. From now you can control the trawldoors from the fullscreen Scanmar screen.

We added a new control sensor, where you use your mouse button/controller to click on the arrow up/down or locked position to control the trawldoors without closing the Scanmar screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38125914/82737f1c7a510bf08e3aa9ee0b86a84021a7bde2.png[/img]

[h3]Crew training[/h3]

We also added crew training. Now you can pay if you want to skill up your crew in ports.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38125914/87e029930b2624e282982010ac93d92dfe6b9edf.png[/img]

[h3]Steering wheel[/h3]

If you experience problems with your Steering wheel, please rename or delete the folder [b]WindowsNoEditor[/b] under [i]C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\FNA\Saved\Config[/i] and then reconfigure the wheel again, this should fix your issue. Also check [url=http://support.miscgames.no/support/solutions/articles/36000269104-how-to-setup-steering-wheel-joysticks-ship-console]here[/url] if you need more details for how to set it up.

[b]Known Issue[/b]

If you experience flickering clouds, you can adjust this with the [b]Sky Quality[/b] setting under [b]Options -> Video[/b] and set it to Epic or Low. We hope to have a fix for this very shortly!

notes.title: Update: 1.6.837.9446
notes.content:
Ahoy all fishermen,

A new update version: 1.6.837.9446 is now ready for download. This is a major update with new features, several improvements and fixes.

[h2]New start option[/h2]

A new start option has been added, you can now select between [b]Easy[/b] or [b]Hard[/b] mode when starting a new game.

[b]Easy[/b] mode, you will start with the fast No Yankee rigged for lobster fishing at 1st of April in the season, everything else will be as before.

[b]Hard[/b] mode, you will start with Mikki rigged for harpooning at 1st of August, fish habitats and prices are reduced by 30%.

[i]NOTE:[/i] You need to start a new game to use these features. Previous savegames will be set to Easy!

[h2]New steel wire lobster pot[/h2]

We added a new steel wire lobster pot, this gives you 30% better yield than wooden pots. We also increased the yield on both wooden and steel pots. Snow crab pots have also got increased yield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38125914/574de40a1853bb4df45e8a3dc1d4ddefef09ea17.png[/img]

[h2]New licensepartner[/h2]

We are happy to announce a new licensepartner [url=https://pronav.no]ProNav[/url]. ProNav delivers products for navigation, communication and security to commercial vessels. You can get their radar as an upgrade for all the bigger boats in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38125914/e821d2e6e3197b727b3e414233203bb109164522.png[/img]

[h2]New bait[/h2]

A new bait have been added to target Silver Hake with longlines.

[h2]Autopilot indicator[/h2]

We added a indicator in the HUD, when the autopilot are enabled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38125914/c9b63876be3d2dedf1e237d48c92809f1ee40588.png[/img]

[h2]Habitat system[/h2]

A reworked habitat system is also in place, making fish availability better over time. You can now see the health status of all the habitats available on the map in your logbook.

We added a new [b]Habitat Extinction[/b] option, when enabled you will need to be more careful with fishing to much on each habitat, to much and its wiped out. Give habitats time to recover to keep them sustainable over time. Without this option enabled, habitat healths will never go below 25%.

Scallop habitats are now found around the map instead of everywhere. Each port will have a dedicated scallop habitat, just ask for some tips for location at the bar in ports.

NOTE: If you experience low habitat messages, please check your [b]Logbook -> Habitats[/b] to see the health of the habitat you are fishing on. The number above the fishtip is the habitat number you see in your logbook.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38125914/1511af13e6872967ed7894db8b9247eed395176d.png[/img]

[h2]Fish prices[/h2]

We balanced the supply and demand for each port, this will help to reduce huge price drops and keep it more consistent over time, even when selling huge loads of fish.

[h2]Catch mackerel with nets[/h2]

You will now be able to catch mackerel using nets.

[h2]Trawling at 100m depths[/h2]

You are now able to trawl on depths at 100m instead of 200m.

notes.title: Version 1.2.437.5286

[previewyoutube=EwTNkwQIz8A;full][/previewyoutube]

Christmas holidays are coming up and this year have been very special for us all, so we are happy to present you all our Christmas gift today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38125914/93636ab98a600af83f0bb5450302d17ced134a0b.png[/img]

Backlit buttons and aluminium throttle levers and steering bar further the immersive feel of handling a rig on the high seas, while anti-skid rubber pads will prevent you from ACTUALLY driving the console off of your desk or table! Generic support will follow in a later update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38125914/6ea19c9a31bfd4105c689152b066a958ec69cc0c.jpg[/img]
